title: PIN-core-db-separation: Core is separated from QNFO's research database
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** trigger: pilot milestone 1
**Done check:** file:docs/migrations/core-db-split.json
**Status:** done: live; verified by the done check on every build

The core's databases (ultrastable-org, ultrastable-ops) are its own, in its own account, with no database of QNFO's research applications bound. Record: docs/migrations/core-db-split.json.

Source: site/pins.json (SITE-PINS-1); the public /engineers and /roadmap pages render this item, and scripts/build_site_roadmap.py --check fails when the claim and the item drift.
